_comment: Valuation model for evaluating MSP / IT-services acquisition targets. Edit these bands as the market moves — the engine reads them at runtime. Multiples are on the stated basis (SDE for owner-operator shops, EBITDA for larger/managed businesses). Sources captured 2026-07-23; re-confirm before relying on them.
sources: Solganick 2025 MSP/MSSP M&A report (466 deals, $4.3B disclosed, +27% YoY, 69% PE-involved)
notes: BizBuySell 'Cash Flow' = SDE (Seller's Discretionary Earnings), i.e. EBITDA + one owner's compensation + add-backs. Small owner-operator shops trade on SDE; sub-$1M-EBITDA managed shops and up trade on EBITDA.

MRR premium: MSPs with 80%+ monthly recurring revenue trade ~1-2 full turns of EBITDA higher than project/break-fix peers. The engine adds `mrrPremiumTurns` to the band when a recurring-revenue signal is present.

break_fix.flag: Break/fix or repair — labor-heavy, low stickiness

offshore.flag: Offshore delivery — transferability / concentration / geopolitical risk

not_operating.flag: Franchise / license / startup — not an operating cash-flowing acquisition

hype.flag: Lifestyle / absentee / hype framing — scrutinize claims
